title: Matric/FSc stream choice by type family
caption:
Choosing a stream for FSc, ICS, I.Com or A-levels? Read this before the family meeting.

Pre-medical because your cousin did it? Pre-engineering because Abbu said so? Your personality deserves a vote too. Here's how each type family tends to feel in each stream: a starting point for a calmer conversation at home, not a final verdict.

Parents, this one is for you too. Save it and share it with a student choosing soon.

Which stream did you pick, and would you pick it again?
